summary: United Kingdom (GB) localization of Business Central 29. It covers Making Tax Digital VAT returns to HMRC, GovTalk and EC Sales List submission, reverse charge VAT, UK postcode address lookup, VAT audit and GB document reports, BACS and check printing, and UK fixed asset depreciation.
overview:
The UK layer adds VAT compliance features. Making Tax Digital objects (MTD codeunits 10530 to 10541, MTD liability, payment and return tables, a fraud prevention headers control add-in) retrieve obligations, submit returns and send fraud prevention headers to HMRC. GovTalk codeunits and extensions of the ECSL report, VAT Report Archive and ECSL VAT Report Line support EC Sales List XML submission. Reverse charge VAT adds fields on items, sales and purchase lines, posted lines and setup tables, with warnings for domestic customers and vendors.

Other additions are address lookup (GetAddress.io and Ideal Postcodes "IPC" objects, with page extensions on customer, vendor, contact, employee, location and company pages), statutory fields on Company Information (registered name and address, supplementary VAT registration number), a posting date check, Intrastat GB export logic, and shipment method fields on item, job and journal entries. There are also many GB report layouts for sales, purchase, reminder, finance charge, check and fixed asset projected value, plus BACS tables.

Learn documents Making Tax Digital, fraud prevention data, reverse charges, VAT audit and VAT reports, APACS checks, remittance advice, Ideal Postcodes setup, the posting date warning, statutory information, Brexit impact and UK straight-line depreciation.
key_points: Making Tax Digital: retrieve VAT obligations, submit returns, view liabilities and payments, with OAuth 2.0 and fraud prevention headers (codeunits 10530 to 10541).
GovTalk and EC Sales List XML submission, with extra fields and events on ECSL report, VAT Report Archive and ECSL VAT Report Line.
Reverse charge VAT: Reverse Charge Applies on Item, Reverse Charge fields on sales and purchase lines, setup fields for posting group, domestic customers and vendors, threshold and invoice wording.
Postcode lookup via GetAddress.io and Ideal Postcodes on customer, vendor, contact, employee, location and company pages.
Statutory fields on Company Information: registered name, address, branch number, supplementary VAT registration number.
VAT audit export (codeunit 10544) and GB reports for sales, purchase, reminders and day book VAT.
Posting Date Check on Posting for sales and purchase setup.
Intrastat GB export and Arrivals/Dispatches Reported flags on Intrastat Jnl. Batch.

areas.what: Adds GovTalk submission, EC Sales List XML creation and archiving, VAT audit export and reverse charge VAT logic. Extends the EC Sales List report, ECSL report page, VAT Report Archive and ECSL VAT Report Line with XML fields and events.
areas.why: Learn describes VAT audit reports and reverse charges on VAT to meet UK auditing requirements and to prevent Missing Trader fraud.

areas.what: Adds postcode address lookup through GetAddress.io and Ideal Postcodes providers, with config pages, search pages and page extensions on address cards. Company Information gains statutory fields (registered name, address, branch number, supplementary VAT number).
areas.why: Learn explains Ideal Postcodes setup with an API key and the Statutory FastTab for UK legal information.

areas.what: Making Tax Digital objects: connection, OAuth 2.0, return content, submission, validation, period receiving, liabilities, payments and fraud prevention header tables and control add-in.
areas.why: Learn describes submitting VAT returns to HMRC and sending fraud prevention headers with MTD API requests.

areas.what: Adds reverse charge fields on sales lines and posted lines, setup fields on Sales & Receivables Setup, postcode lookup on customer pages, and GB sales document reports.
areas.why: Learn covers reverse charge setup with domestic customers and invoice wording.

areas.what: Adds reverse charge fields on purchase lines and setup, Invoice Receipt Date, Exclude from Pmt. Pract. Rep. on vendors, a Reference No. on vendor bank accounts, and GB purchase reports.
Adds Intrastat GB export logic, reported flags on Intrastat batches, Reverse Charge Applies on items, and Shipment Method Code on item entries and journal lines.
areas.why: Learn's Brexit page covers Intrastat reporting and Northern Ireland trade requirements.

areas.what: Adds BACS ledger entry and register tables, a GB check preview page, and changes to the Check report, including employee balancing. Bank reconciliation lines get a Reconciled field.
areas.why: Learn describes printing APACS checks from payment journals.

areas.what: Changes depreciation calculation and FA Depreciation Book, and extends the projected value report.
areas.why: Learn explains straight-line depreciation over up to 13 accounting periods.

areas.what: Adds a Posting Date Check codeunit and table extensions on sales and purchase setup.
areas.why: Learn describes the posting date warning toggle on both setup pages.

areas.what: Changes the Cash Flow Dimensions - Detail report with a report extension.
Contact Card and Contact Alt. Address Card get postcode lookup procedures.
Adds FA - Projected Value reports for the UK.
areas.why: Learn covers the FA - Projected Value report for UK depreciation.

areas.what: Changes the LOCAL and LOCAL READ permission sets.
Adds an expense event subscriber for GB.
Employee Card gets postcode lookup procedures.
Job Ledger Entry gets a Shipment Method Code field.
Adds a procedure in Rolecenter Selector Mgt. for role center overview setup after login.

issues: Minor: the reverse charge threshold fields ('Threshold applies', 'Threshold Amount') are on General Ledger Setup, not on the sales or purchase setup tables. The key point lists them with the other setup fields without saying which table holds them.

Minor: Purchase Line gets only 'Reverse Charge Item'. The 'Reverse Charge' field is on Sales Line, posted sales and purchase lines and VAT Amount Line. 'Reverse Charge fields on sales and purchase lines' is a little loose.
Minor: 'shipment method fields on item, job and journal entries' means Item Ledger Entry, Job Ledger Entry and Item Journal Line. 'Journal entries' is imprecise.

Omission, not an error: several changes are not mentioned. These are 'Invoice Receipt Date' on Purchase Header, Vendor Ledger Entry and general journal lines, 'Exclude from Pmt. Pract. Rep.' on Vendor, 'Reference No.' on Vendor Bank Account, 'Freight/Insurance' on Item Charge, and the Learn topic on the Copy VAT Setup to Jnl. Lines option.
